svg.title: Achievements
svg.desc: NPTEL Elite + Gold in IoT, ranked in the top 1% of 43,953 candidates. Received a 12-week paid internship opportunity from IIT Kharagpur through the NPTEL achievement. Completed a Full stack developer Internship @amasqis.ai on a production-oriented PPE Compliance / Computer Vision system. Built full-stack systems involving authentication, RBAC, multi-tenancy, databases and REST APIs. solved 450+ DSA problems on various Coding Platforms such as Leetcode, Geeks for Geeks, Codeforces, Hackerrank.
